---
title: "Flashcards"
subtitle: "Every statute and every key term. Click a card or press the space bar to flip it."
toc: false
---

```{r}
source("R/helpers.R")
statutes <- load_statutes()
units    <- load_units()
links    <- official_links(statutes)

unit_of <- function(id) {
  hits <- purrr::keep(units, \(u) id %in% c(u$core, u$further))
  paste(purrr::map_chr(hits, "id"), collapse = " ")
}

statute_cards <- statutes |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(links, id, enact_link, code_link), by = "id") |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    kind = "statute", id, front = short, hint = paste(year, "·", domain_name),
    back = plain_wiki(summary, statutes),
    meta = paste(status_label, "·", layer_label, dplyr::if_else(is.na(usc), "", paste("·", usc))),
    domain, historic, url = paste0("../statutes/", id, ".html"),
    official = dplyr::coalesce(enact_link, code_link),
    units = purrr::map_chr(id, unit_of)
  )

term_cards <- purrr::map(units, \(u) purrr::map(u$terms, \(t) tibble::tibble(
  kind = "term", id = paste0(u$id, "-", tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z]+", "-", t$term))),
  front = t$term, hint = paste0("Key term, Unit ", u$number), back = t$definition,
  meta = u$title, domain = "", historic = FALSE, url = paste0("units/", u$id, ".html"),
  official = NA_character_, units = u$id
)) |> purrr::list_rbind()) |>
  purrr::list_rbind()

cards <- dplyr::bind_rows(statute_cards, term_cards)
```

```{r}
                    purrr::map_chr(units, "title"), "</option>", collapse = "")
dom_opts <- paste0("<option value=\"", names(domain_short), "\">", domain_short, "</option>", collapse = "")
cat(
  "<div class=\"fc-controls\">",

  "<option value=\"statute\">Statutes</option><option value=\"term\">Key terms</option></select></label>",
  "<label>Unit <select id=\"fc-unit\"><option value=\"\">All units</option>", unit_opts, "</select></label>",
  "<label>Domain <select id=\"fc-domain\"><option value=\"\">All domains</option>", dom_opts, "</select></label>",
  "<label class=\"inline-toggle\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"fc-unknown\"> Only cards I don't know yet</label>",
  "<button type=\"button\" id=\"fc-shuffle\" class=\"link-button\">Shuffle</button>",
  "</div>",
  "<div class=\"fc-stage\">",
  "<div id=\"fc-card\" class=\"fc-card\" tabindex=\"0\" role=\"button\" aria-label=\"Flip card\"></div>",
  "<div class=\"fc-buttons\">",
  "<button type=\"button\" id=\"fc-prev\">Previous</button>",
  "<button type=\"button\" id=\"fc-again\" class=\"fc-again\">Still learning</button>",
  "<button type=\"button\" id=\"fc-know\" class=\"fc-know\">I know this</button>",
  "<button type=\"button\" id=\"fc-next\">Next</button>",
  "</div>",
  "<p id=\"fc-status\" class=\"fc-status\"></p>",
  "</div>",
  "<script>window.FLASHCARDS = ", jsonlite::toJSON(cards, na = "null"), ";</script>",
  sep = "\n"
)
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var all = window.FLASHCARDS || [];
  var deck = [], i = 0, flipped = false;
  function known(id) { try { return localStorage.getItem("wiki-card-" + id) === "1"; } catch (e) { return false; } }
  function setKnown(id, v) { try { localStorage.setItem("wiki-card-" + id, v ? "1" : "0"); } catch (e) {} }
  function val(id) { return document.getElementById(id).value; }

  function build(shuffle) {
    var kind = val("fc-kind"), unit = val("fc-unit"), dom = val("fc-domain");
    var onlyUnknown = document.getElementById("fc-unknown").checked;
    var hide = window.wikiHideHistoric && window.wikiHideHistoric();
    deck = all.filter(function (c) {
      if (kind !== "all" && c.kind !== kind) return false;
      if (unit && (" " + c.units + " ").indexOf(" " + unit + " ") < 0) return false;
      if (dom && c.domain !== dom) return false;
      if (hide && c.historic) return false;
      if (onlyUnknown && known(c.id)) return false;
      return true;
    });
    if (shuffle) for (var k = deck.length - 1; k > 0; k--) {
      var j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (k + 1)); var t = deck[k]; deck[k] = deck[j]; deck[j] = t;
    }
    i = 0; flipped = false; draw();
  }

  function draw() {
    var card = document.getElementById("fc-card");
    var status = document.getElementById("fc-status");
    var knownCount = deck.filter(function (c) { return known(c.id); }).length;
    if (!deck.length) {
      card.innerHTML = '<div class="fc-front"><p>No cards match. Change the filters above.</p></div>';
      status.textContent = ""; return;
    }
    var c = deck[i];
    card.classList.toggle("flipped", flipped);
    card.classList.toggle("is-known", known(c.id));
    card.setAttribute("data-domain", c.domain || "");
    card.innerHTML = flipped
      ? '<div class="fc-back"><p>' + c.back + '</p><p class="fc-meta">' + c.meta + '</p><p class="fc-links"><a href="' + c.url + '">Open the page</a>' +
        (c.official ? ' · <a href="' + c.official + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Official text</a>' : '') + '</p></div>'
      : '<div class="fc-front"><div class="fc-title">' + c.front + '</div><div class="fc-hint">' + c.hint + '</div><div class="fc-tap">Click or press space to flip</div></div>';
    status.textContent = "Card " + (i + 1) + " of " + deck.length + " · You know " + knownCount + " of these";
  }

  function move(d) { if (!deck.length) return; i = (i + d + deck.length) % deck.length; flipped = false; draw(); }
  function flip() { flipped = !flipped; draw(); }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    ["fc-kind", "fc-unit", "fc-domain", "fc-unknown"].forEach(function (id) {
      document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("change", function () { build(false); });
    });
    document.getElementById("fc-shuffle").addEventListener("click", function () { build(true); });
    document.getElementById("fc-card").addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (e.target.tagName !== "A") flip(); });
    document.getElementById("fc-prev").addEventListener("click", function () { move(-1); });
    document.getElementById("fc-next").addEventListener("click", function () { move(1); });
    document.getElementById("fc-know").addEventListener("click", function () { if (deck.length) { setKnown(deck[i].id, true); move(1); } });
    document.getElementById("fc-again").addEventListener("click", function () { if (deck.length) { setKnown(deck[i].id, false); move(1); } });
    document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
      if (e.target.tagName === "SELECT" || e.target.tagName === "INPUT") return;
      if (e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); flip(); }
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") move(1);
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") move(-1);
    });
    document.addEventListener("wiki:historic", function () { build(false); });
    build(false);
  });
})();
</script>
```

Your tally is saved in this browser only. Keyboard: space flips, left and right arrows move.
